# Diffusion, viscosity and forcing {#sec-ch09}

<!-- PROVENANCE
pin: snapy@e894700ff7aee30b52882e5202b16461413780b0 (chengcli/snapy); kintera@c55b13b2204997d2d09e04498558ab9495d8ee77

This chapter covers every source term snapy adds to the stage increment besides the flux divergence and gravity:
the forcing framework that parses, installs and sums them; user stage forcings written in TorchScript; the
Coriolis force; the isotropic viscosity and heat conduction with their face coefficients at walls and their
optional $x_1$ profiles; prescribed heating and cooling; the bottom relaxations of temperature, velocity and
composition; and the sponge layers. All of them are explicit and act through the same increment, in a fixed order
that does not change the result. Constant gravity and its work are @sec-ch06; sedimentation is @sec-ch10. Two
entries record code that is present but never runs: the plume forcing and the unbuilt turbulence closure.

<!-- PENDING: the chapter's dependency map (STYLE.md section 10.1) is drawn from the switch coverage matrix of the configuration chapter, which is not in the book yet. -->

| scheme | switch | default | order | main test |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Forcing framework (@sec-ch09-framework) | `forcing:` keys | none | — | `test_forcing` |
| User stage forcings (@sec-ch09-user) | `set_user_stage_forcings` | none | user | `test_stage_forcing_dry_tracer_python` |
| Coriolis (@sec-ch09-coriolis) | `coriolis` | off | exact pointwise | `test_forcing` |
| Viscosity and conduction (@sec-ch09-viscosity) | `diffusion` | off | 2 (1 at walls) | `test_diffusion` |
| Wall face coefficient (@sec-ch09-wallcoef) | automatic | on at named walls | 2 | `test_diffusion` |
| $x_1$ coefficient profiles (@sec-ch09-x1profile) | `nu_scale_x1`, `kappa_scale_x1` | none | 2 | `test_diffusion_x1_scale` |
| Heating and cooling (@sec-ch09-heating) | `body-heat`, `top-cool`, `bot-heat` | off | exact pointwise | `test_forcing` |
| Bottom relaxation (@sec-ch09-relax) | `relax-bot-temp`, `-velo`, `-comp` | off | 1 in time | `test_forcing` |
| Sponge layers (@sec-ch09-sponge) | `top-sponge-lyr`, `bot-sponge-lyr` | off | 1 in time | `test_forcing` |
| Plume forcing (@sec-ch09-plume) | `plume-forcing` | never installed | — | none |
| Turbulence (@sec-ch09-turbulence) | none | not built | — | none |

: The schemes of this chapter. "Order" is the spatial order of the discrete operator, or the order in time for the
relaxations; all are explicit. {#tbl-ch09-schemes}
